inputs.userGoal: Please fix it the most reliable way so I it doesn't break again! It keep breaking
subGoals: Respect private-network and disabled-Shared-Key governance instead of repeatedly reopening endpoints.
Preserve existing data, credentials, identities, compute tiers and unrelated work.
Limit deployment to API login dependencies; retain the Consumption worker unchanged.
insightsApplied: existing-storage: private Blob/Queue access using existing API RBAC.
existing-cosmos: private MongoDB endpoint with existing vault-held credentials.
existing-vault: private endpoint, Linux route-all and forced reference refresh.
existing-api: same-region delegated subnet, Always On and dependency health checks.
existing-worker: explicitly exclude separate hosting migration.
existing-registry: publish only the scoped code changes with a unique image tag.

reasoning.whyChosen: Regional B1 outbound integration reaches private dependencies without replacing compute.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Single-region B1 retained; no zone redundancy upgrade.

reasoning.whyChosen: Attach an NSG to both subnets while retaining required Azure identity and service egress.
reasoning.tradeoffs: No centralized firewall; no public ingress is added.

reasoning.whyChosen: Private links remain reachable when governance disables public access.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Approximately US$30-40/month plus traffic; endpoint approval is verified.

reasoning.whyChosen: Normal service hostnames resolve to managed endpoint addresses; zone groups maintain regional Cosmos records.
reasoning.tradeoffs: Azure-provided VNet DNS; no custom DNS resolver needed.

overallReasoning.summary: Add only network resources in the existing resource group; reference existing data services. Apply separately approved CLI changes to API outbound integration, identity storage configuration, image, Always On and health check. Keep public networking and Shared Key disabled. Bicep is retained because this repository already uses it.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: Existing Mongo RU credentials remain vault-backed because NoSQL managed-identity authentication is not applicable. The Y1 worker is already incompatible with private storage and is not repaired by this login change. Existing observability, AI, email, web, compute and Grafana insights marked retain are deliberately unchanged. No geo-HA, Premium plans, worker migration or new alert notification destination is included.

plan.validation: Deployed incrementally with existing data services unchanged and all four endpoint connections Approved. API Key Vault references are Resolved; /healthz reports database/blob/queue OK. Hosted same-origin login, authenticated process listing, session survival across an API restart, and logout all passed using an existing account without logging credentials. Public access remains Disabled on all three dependencies and Storage Shared Key remains disabled. Local identity/fallback tests: 4 passed; lint and scoped mypy passed. Both Bicep entry points compile (latest resource types produce local schema warnings); ARM what-if verified additive changes. Checkov scoped compiled additive template: 5 passed, 0 failed. Full legacy infra scan: 44 passed, 28 existing broader findings, not claimed clean and not deployed by this repair. Legacy emulator round-trip tests could not complete without the local emulators; live private dependency health and hosted authentication were verified instead.
